text: Setting clear project goals is key to success. A popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. To track progress, break the project into milestones—important checkpoints along the way. You should also define deliverables, the tangible results you will hand over at the end. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the start. This alignment prevents confusion and keeps everyone focused on the same vision. When goals, milestones, and deliverables are clear, your project is much more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
